thread:
maya: Quick sync — need decision on on-prem packaging defaults for Q3 customers with strict netops. Options: (1) minimal-agent (small footprint, customer-managed networking), (2) full-distro (includes router + sidecars, easier ops), (3) hybrid (edge proxy + agent). Each has SLA/cost implications. Can product + eng list tradeoffs by EOD?

devon: thanks. can we get a table of rough numbers? tokens-per-sec, CPU/GPU reqs, expected median latency, infra ops burden.

alex: +1. Also need to call out upgrade path: can we upgrade from minimal->full without reinstall? that's a hard ask from field.

samir: from runtime side: minimal-agent reduces attack surface and is easiest for air-gapped, but requires customer's network routing for control plane; full-distro enables automatic health checks and fallback routing. Hybrid buys flexibility.

nate: field: 2 pilot customers prefer minimal due to firewall policies. One enterprise wants full-distro for single-vendor support.

eva: legal/compliance flagged KMS/HSM integration differences between options. full-distro complicates key rotation since we manage more services in-customer.

maya: can eng propose a default that minimizes lift for customers but keeps upgrade path? maybe default to minimal-agent w/ opt-in full-distro? thoughts?

devon: numeric ask — rough delta: minimal -> full: increase infra ops by ~20%, cost +15% in packaging support. Upgrade complexity: if we design "operator shim" it can be seamless, else requires migration window.

alex: proposal: default minimal-agent v1 with an operator shim v2 path that adds sidecars via Helm CRs. Add "revert" playbook in runbook. That lets field choose to opt-in.

ops-bot: RFC created: https://intranet.redwood/rfcs/packaging-paths-1771234567 — please comment by 2024-07-10

samir: perf notes: quantization & caching unchanged. full distro helps with observability out of box (traces/metrics).

maya: next steps: eng to make a short AD (architecture decision) doc with rollback story + migration commands by Thu; product to draft comms and pricing delta; field to list customers for pilot.

devon: I'll draft the AD. @alex can you own migration commands?

alex: yep. I'll prototype Helm CRD + sample `kubectl apply -f` steps. snippet:

```
apiVersion: redwood/v1
kind: OperatorShim
metadata:
  name: enable-sidecars
spec:
  mode: full
```

eva: noted, legal will need the comms draft before pilot.

nate: adding: some customers need static IP preserver for upgrade — include in migration checklist.

maya: TY all. Follow-ups in RFC thread + quick 1hr sync tomorrow 11am PT if needed. :thumbsup:
